rationale: Adds user-configurable per-vacuum trail colour and opacity and an accepted vacuum settings presentation, absent from stable v1.82.0. Optional fields need no data migration; existing trail arbitration and calibration remain unchanged.

summary.ru: Индивидуальные цвет и прозрачность тонкого пути пылесоса, обновлённые настройки и карты.
summary.en: Individual thin vacuum trail colour and opacity, refreshed settings and map cards.
